icwt_cycle_programme = {
if = { limit = { icwt_core = yes NOT = { icwt_pending = yes } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { icwt_edit_programme > 0 } } clear_variable = icwt_edit_programme }
else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { icwt_template = 9 } USA = { has_country_flag = icwt_programme_1_unlocked } } set_variable = { icwt_edit_programme = 1 } }
else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { icwt_template = 8 } USA = { has_country_flag = icwt_programme_2_unlocked } } set_variable = { icwt_edit_programme = 2 } }
else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { icwt_template = 1 } USA = { has_country_flag = icwt_programme_3_unlocked } } set_variable = { icwt_edit_programme = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { icwt_template = 10 } USA = { has_country_flag = icwt_programme_4_unlocked } } set_variable = { icwt_edit_programme = 4 } }
clear_variable = icwt_review_revision icwt_touch = yes }
}
icwt_programme_quote_setup = {
set_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 0 }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.icwt_p_programme = 1 } }
set_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = gdp_total }
multiply_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 0.0003 }
divide_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 100 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.icwt_p_programme = 2 } }
set_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = gdp_total }
multiply_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 0.001 }
divide_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 100 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.icwt_p_programme = 3 } }
set_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = gdp_total }
multiply_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 0.0005 }
divide_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 100 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.icwt_p_programme = 4 } tag = USA }
set_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = gdp_total }
multiply_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 0.0005 }
divide_variable = { icwt_programme_setup = 100 }
}
}
icwt_programmes_refresh = {
if = { limit = { icwt_programme_1_active = yes } if = { limit = { country_exists = USA } USA = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_1_usa } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_1_usa } } } if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_1_sov } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_1_sov } } } } else = { USA = { remove_ideas = icwt_programme_1_usa } SOV = { remove_ideas = icwt_programme_1_sov } }
if = { limit = { icwt_programme_2_active = yes } if = { limit = { country_exists = USA } USA = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_2_usa } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_2_usa } } } if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_2_sov } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_2_sov } } } } else = { USA = { remove_ideas = icwt_programme_2_usa } SOV = { remove_ideas = icwt_programme_2_sov } }
if = { limit = { icwt_programme_3_active = yes } if = { limit = { country_exists = USA } USA = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_3_usa } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_3_usa } } } if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_3_sov } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_3_sov } } } } else = { USA = { remove_ideas = icwt_programme_3_usa } SOV = { remove_ideas = icwt_programme_3_sov } }
if = { limit = { icwt_programme_4_active = yes } if = { limit = { country_exists = USA } USA = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_4_usa } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_4_usa } } } if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_4_sov } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_4_sov } } } } else = { USA = { if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_USA_KS_td_regional_active = yes } } remove_ideas = icwt_programme_4_usa } } SOV = { remove_ideas = icwt_programme_4_sov } }
if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { COLDWAR_USA_KS_td_regional_active = yes } } USA = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = icwt_programme_4_usa } } add_ideas = icwt_programme_4_usa } } }
}
